questions.q: Explain one reason governments try to reduce sugar today. (2 marks)
questions.a: Too much sugar causes obesity and tooth decay (1), which cost the NHS money and harm health (1)

questions.q: Core (assessed): In the portal response box, write the end-of-enquiry essay: 'How did the sugar trade and its impact on people change from AD 350 to the present?' using your change table.
questions.a: Assessed: knowledge across all periods, explanation of change, judgement

questions.q: Extend: Add a paragraph on continuity: what stayed the same?
questions.a: Demand for sweetness; profits for traders; workers often poorly paid

questions.q: The UK soft drinks sugar levy began in:
questions.a: B) 2018. The Soft Drinks Industry Levy started in April 2018.

questions.q: Adults should have no more than about how much free sugar a day?
Big question: is sugar still causing harm today?
questions.a: Yes: health harms from overeating, and some sugar workers are still poorly paid
